facts.statement: Double Station Cash was offered from 12:01 AM PDT on September 2, 2011 to 11:59 PM PDT on September 5, 2011, when redeeming an SOE Pre-Paid Station Cash Card or with any purchase of Station Cash (excluding SMS payments).
facts.quote: Get Double Station Cash® between 12:01 AM PDT on September 2, 2011, and 11:59 PM PDT on September 5, 2011

article_summaries.title: Back to School Bonanza: Double SC Weekend!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post promoting a Back to School Bonanza Double Station Cash weekend, with Free Realms listed among participating games. The Free Realms-specific content is a 50% discount on New School Items in the Marketplace. The post gives no exact posting date beyond a relative 'posted 2 months, 2 days ago' on the capture date.
